newsitem.title: UK: PORTUGUESE TECNICREDITO PLANS LOAN SECURITISATION.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGUESE TECNICREDITO PLANS LOAN SECURITISATION.

text.p: Portuguese auto finance group Tecnicredito Financiamento de Aquisicoes a Credito SA has set up a 10 billion escudo ($53.5 million) loan securitisation programme, arranger Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a statement on Monday.
It will access the international asset-backed commercial paper (CP) market from early September and use the proceeds to fund Tecnicredito's high level of growth, the statement said.

Tecnicredito, established in 1987, was the first company in the Portuguese auto financing market. It will be the first Portuguese institution to tap the international capital markets through a securitised transaction, Deutsche said.

Tecnicredito will sell loan receivables into an A1+/P1-rated CP programme for up to four years through a revolving sale agreement. The consumer loans within the portfolio will have an average life of three years.
-- Aline van Duyn, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7748 ($ = 186.8 Portugese Escudos)
